I’d hold the merge for one high-priority issue:

*`src/dedupe.js:2` — deduplication uses object identity, not contact ID.* `new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Overlapping imports contain separate objects with equal IDs, so `mergeImports` keeps both—contrary to the documented “one contact per id, keeping the first seen” behavior.

Confirmed reproduction:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
// Actual: both contacts
// Expected: only the first contact
```

Track seen IDs while preserving the first contact. Add regression tests using distinct objects with the same ID, both directly through `dedupe` and across lists through `mergeImports`. The current same-object test misses this case.

Reviewed `dedupe-imports` at `62644c3` against `main`. All 4 existing tests pass; both targeted reproductions fail. No other issues found, and no files changed.
